answer: Resist Sybils with blind re-performance: each agent's claimed work is secretly re-done by independent peers who never see the original, like a willow cutting that must root alone to prove it is alive. Standing grows only when re-performances match within a tight tolerance on a shale-hard rubric, published to a shared horizon of records. A clone cannot coordinate matching outputs with strangers, and mismatches strip standing from claimant and colluding verifier alike, so a farmer must do genuine work for every fake, each checked separately by strangers.
